components.title: AWS FedRAMP Shared Responsibility Controls
components.description: Controls with shared responsibility between AWS (platform) and SPARC (configuration/monitoring). These controls are partially inherited from the AWS FedRAMP authorization, with customer-specific implementation documented in individual infrastructure and application CDEFs. Source: AWS SSP Appendix J — CRM Workbook (v26.01.U).

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls with shared AWS/customer responsibility

implemented-requirements.description: Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: AC-12. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for configuring their systems to automatically terminate a user session after [Assignment: organization-defined conditions or trigger events requiring session disconnect].

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: AC-17.a, AC-17.b. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for establishing and documenting usage restrictions, configuration/connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: AU-11. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for retaining audit records for a period of [FedRAMP Assignment: at least one (1) year] or for a period defined by their audit and accountability policy to provide support for after-the-fact investigations of security incidents and to meet regulatory and organizational

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: AU-12.a, AU-12.b, AU-12.c. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for providing audit record generation capability for the auditable events defined in AU-2 a. at [FedRAMP Assignment: all information system components where audit capability is deployed/available].

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: CM-11.a, CM-11.b, CM-11.c. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for establishing [Assignment: organization-defined policies] governing the installation of software by users.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: IA-11. Customer responsibility: Customers are responsible for requiring users to re-authenticate when [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances or situations requiring re-authentication].

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: IA-12.a, IA-12.b, IA-12.c. Customer responsibility: Customers are responsible for identity proofing users that require accounts for logical access to systems based on appropriate identity assurance level requirements as specified in applicable standards and guidelines.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SA-11.a, SA-11.b, SA-11.c, SA-11.d, SA-11.e. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for requiring the developer of the information system, system component, or information system service to create and implement a security assessment plan.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SA-15.a, SA-15.b. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for requiring the developer of the information system, system component, or information system service to follow a documented development process that: (1) Explicitly addresses security requirements; (2) Identifies the standards and tools used in the development process

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SC-12. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for establishing and managing cryptographic keys for required cryptography employed within their system in accordance with organization-defined requirements for key generation, distribution, storage, access, and destruction.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SC-13.a, SC-13.b. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for determining the [Assignment: organization-defined cryptographic uses].

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SC-17.a, SC-17.b. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for issuing public key certificates under an organization-defined certificate policy or obtaining public key certificates from an approved service provider.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SC-20.a, SC-20.b. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for providing additional data origin authentication and integrity verification artifacts along with the authoritative name resolution data the system returns in response to external name/address resolution queries.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SC-21. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for configuring their systems to perform data origin authentication and data integrity verification on DNS resolution responses received from authoritative sources.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SC-22. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for ensuring that information systems collectively providing name resolution services to their organization are fault-tolerant and have implemented internal/external role separation.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SC-23. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for configuring their systems to protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SC-28. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for configuring their systems to protect the confidentiality and/or integrity of organization-defined information at rest in accordance with their system and communications protection policy.

Shared responsibility with AWS CSP. AWS provides the platform capability (FedRAMP authorized infrastructure). The customer (SPARC) configures, monitors, and documents use through Terraform IaC and/or application controls. Parts: SI-10. Customer responsibility: AWS customers are responsible for configuring their systems to check the validity of organization-defined inputs.
